title: 「768pxだから崩す」って、768pxは何をしたん？
titleEn: Why Does 768px Get to Decide Everything?
series: Design Literacy｜細部から思想まで
description: 768pxという慣習的なbreakpointを疑い、端末幅ではなくcontentが壊れる瞬間からResponsive Designを考え直す。
descriptionEn: Rethinking responsive breakpoints by asking what actually fails at 768px, and moving from device categories to content-driven intervention points.
